Claude Code isn't tired after an hour. Its context is full 🧠

I checked my own logs: after one hour, my typical session held almost half a million tokens. The docs say it plainly, performance drops as the context fills up.

The fix is 4 commands: /context to see what fills it, /compact with what to keep, /clear for a new task, /resume to get the old chat back.

Comment CONTEXT and I'll send you all four.

People search sites can show your phone number to anyone who types your name.

So I sent a robot (read only) to 5 of their removal pages, 3 times. TruePeopleSearch, BeenVerified and FastPeopleSearch blocked it every time, before the page even loaded. Spokeo and Whitepages opened.

Anthropic says Claude in Chrome runs in your own browser and fills in forms like a person would. The captcha and the confirmation email link stay with you.

I tried to trick 4 AIs with the same question 🧠

A farmer, a wolf, a goat and a cabbage, and his boat fits all of them at once. How many crossings?

ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity all said one, which is right. Claude said one too, and it called the question a trap. Back in 2024, some AI models said five on puzzles like this.

Then I added one custom instruction, and now it splits every answer into what it knows for sure and what it's guessing.
